title: Welcome to the Hype Type Revealer | FCA
text: When you start, you'll be asked to choose your profile image and username before entering the group chat simulation. Throughout, you'll see a series of investment opportunities (these are not real investments). Your responses are measured instantly, using behavioural science to calculate your hype type. It takes less than 5 minutes to complete and at the end you'll find out your hype type and receive your personalised tips and tricks. Don't worry, there's no sign-up required. You just need to put in your first name. That's only stored for the duration of the session and will never be shared publicly. What will the Hype Type Revealer tell you about how you react to investment hype? Click below to enter the Hype Type Revealer and become a smarter investor. Start now
